issues.location: persistent quantifier expansion and finite open branches
issues.finding: The term-selection instruction is undefined when no unused applicable term remains, and the finite-open-branch description requires all non-atomic formulas checked even though true-universal and false-existential formulas are never checked.
issues.proposed_resolution: Skip expansion when no unused applicable term exists, reconsider when new terms appear, and characterize finite open branches by checked checkable formulas plus saturation of all persistent quantifier instances.
